description:
Fix critical bugs discovered in adversarial review that cause silent failures,
incorrect behavior, and potential performance/security issues. These are P0
issues that must be fixed before the query plan feature can be considered
production-ready.

**Problems Addressed**:
- Silent capture failures (no error signaling to user)
- Operator ID counter leakage across queries (breaks comparison)
- Unbounded serialization (can cause memory/storage issues)
- Inefficient BFS queue (O(n) pop operations)
- No timeout protection on EXPLAIN queries (can hang benchmarks)
